headline: Oil rises amid uncertainty over Iran and Oman negotiations
summary: Oil prices rose on Thursday, 6 August, as investors watched negotiations between Iran and Oman on resuming shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Uncertainty over the talks supported prices.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so shipping disruptions there directly affect crude supply and prices.
why_moved: Oil rose as investors watched Iran-Oman negotiations on resuming shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, with the outcome uncertain.
